route.description: Route captured, including any query string

viewport.description: Which viewport bucket the capture was taken at

width.description: Actual capture width in CSS pixels

height.description: Actual capture height in CSS pixels

image_url.description: Uploaded PNG. Empty when capture_status is failed.

capture_status.description: failed captures are kept so the gap is visible rather than looking like a page that was never reviewed

failure_reason.description: Why the capture did not succeed

masked.description: Whether personal data was redacted before rasterising. Unmasked captures of live lead data must never be retained.

mask_count.description: How many elements were redacted. Zero on a lead page is suspicious and worth checking.

role_used.description: Role of the account that took the capture. A buyer-role capture would show buyer-scoped data.

app_commit.description: Manifest commit at capture time, so a snapshot can be tied to the code that produced it

superseded.description: Set when a newer capture exists for the same page and viewport
